title: Man shot to death in fight at Chelsea/East Boston football game
summary: A fight among fans that erupted near the end of the Chelsea/East Boston Thanksgiving football game at Chelsea High School tonight ended with a man in his late 20s fatally shot, the Suffolk County District Attorney's office and Chelsea Police report. Chelsea Police report that the fight broke out along the sidelines around 7:44 p.m. The victim, Robert Acosta, 29, of Boston, was taken to Mass. General, where he was pronounced dead.
